heading: Sort, then sweep
body:
Intervals = `[start, end]` pairs (meetings, time slots). The trick: **sort by start time**, then sweep through.

After sorting, you only compare each interval with the **previous one** — no nested loops needed.

Sorting transforms chaos into structure.

heading: Overlap check in one line
body:
After sorting by start, two intervals overlap if:

```python
current[0] < previous[1]
```

Meaning: **current starts before previous ends**.

To merge: `previous[1] = max(previous[1], current[1])`

options: The two intervals share the same start time
